      About this project
      A hybrid machine learning and business intelligence framework for employee attrition prediction, assessment, and workforce optimization.
      Dataset snapshot
      How this dashboard works

      Everything on this page — the HR dashboard, the prediction engine, and the model performance report — runs client-side in a single HTML file. The employee dataset is embedded directly in the page (or supplied by you via the Data Explorer's upload button). A logistic regression classifier is trained in your browser using gradient descent on standardized features, so the metrics you see reflect this exact dataset, recalculated on every load.

      There is no backend, no database, and no data leaves your machine — it is designed to be hosted as a static file on GitHub Pages.
